page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Page number at top right. Signature "B 4" centred below the last line, catchword "er-" at the right below it. No running head. Small marks at the left edge are the edge of the neighbouring page and are left out.

main_text.p: occupauit. Idque ita esse hac Dissertatione planum fit. Sed hanc esse Oecumenicam nemo nisi amentissimus dixerit. Quis enim Oecumenicam dixerit, in qua nulla potestas, nullum ius Ecclesiasticum, sed omnia ad nutum, & placitum iniquissimorum hominum peracta sunt?

Et licet hanc Tertiam Paulus, & Eugenius Ioannis Noni Legationibus functi cum praesi-dendi ritu inter Episcopos tercentum & octogin-ta permunirent, & non solum Photium muneri suo redonatum, sed cuncta a Photio, & Synodo propofita suffragijs corroborarent, Latini tamen Latrocinalis nomine infamant, & multis obiurgationibus inuehuntur in Photium, in totam gentem Graecorum, in Legatos proprios bis praevaricantes, in ipsos Pontifices ludificatos Nicolaum, & Ioannem. Deplorandam hominis infscitiam[?]! Paulus, & Eugenius Ioannis Noni legationibus functi. Ioannes Nonus creatus est Pontifex Anno 901, post restitutionem Photij annos 24. cum e viuis sub-lato Photio usque ad restitutum Nicolaum Mysticum Ioannes Nonus Theodoro subro-gatur, in Throno Constantinopolitano se-diffent[?], Stephanus frater Leonis Imperatoris, Antonius Cauleas, Nicolaus ex Mysti-co, Euthymius Monachus ex Syncello, & iterum restitutus Nicolaus Mysticus. Non

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "infscitiam" (the letters before "citiam" are unclear, possibly a printing error for "infcitiam"); "diffent" (printed with ff-like letters, probably "dissent"). Printing errors left as printed: "diffent", "infscitiam". Italic boundaries are approximate, especially where the italic ends after "corroborarent," and in "Paulus, & Eugenius". Page number "23" is at the top right. No marginal notes are printed.
